headlines.title: Alaska governor orders investigation into Peltola camp after report they recruited second Dan Sullivan
headlines.description: Alaska Gov. Mike Dunleavy announced Thursday that he is ordering an investigation into Democrat Mary Peltola’s Senate campaign after a report that it worked with allies to recruit a candidate with the same name as incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan in an effort to dilute his votes.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Patrick Stewart, actor known for iconic roles of Jean-Luc Picard and Professor X, dies at 86
headlines.description: Beloved actor Patrick Stewart has died following a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia, his official social media pages announced.

headlines.title: Neither Israeli party is expected to win an outright majority in the elections
headlines.description: Neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his challenger Gadi Eisenkot is projected to win an outright parliamentary majority with more than 90% of the vote counted. NBC News’ Matt Bradley breaks down the election results and what they could mean for Israel’s political future.

headlines.title: RFK Jr. takes shortcut to make some unapproved peptides available for use
headlines.description: HHS is pausing legal action against compounding pharmacies that make certain peptides, effectively allowing them to offer the unapproved drugs immediately.

headlines.title: Polymarket briefly halts trading after third-party compromise and reports of stolen user funds
headlines.description: Predictions markets platform Polymarket was forced to halt trading on its international platform for an hour after a vendor was compromised.

headlines.title: Death Toll Rises in High-Speed Train Crash in Spain
headlines.description: A massive recovery operation is underway in Spain with anger growing among the public after a violent high-speed train collision. Crews are searching for any additional victims as the death toll rises. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lawyers fighting N.Y. AG’s role in Cornell assault investigation say she is not ‘viable’ as prosecutor
headlines.description: Lawyers for one of seven former Cornell fraternity members accused in a high-profile sexual assault suit argued in court that Letitia James should be removed as prosecutor.

headlines.title: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart For $17 Billion
headlines.description: DoorDash plans to acquire Instacart in a deal worth about $17 billion. It’s expected to close at the end of 2027 in the first half of 2028. The acquisition would combine DoorDash’s dominance in restaurant delivery with Instacart’s lineup of grocery partnerships, creating one company to delivery customer’s weekly dining needs.

headlines.title: The former youth pastor leading one of the NFL’s best offenses
headlines.description: Nate Scheelhaase, the Los Angeles Rams’ offensive coordinator, is a former youth pastor. He credits time in the church for his success in professional football.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.
